evidence.why: The query reads masked pressed_buttons without mutation.
Press events are derived from held-state differences and either replaced or OR-latched.

facts.rationale: Corrects the existing once-per-press implication while preserving the supported edge-event interpretation and explicitly accounting for latching.
facts.value: Exposes pending fighter button-press events through a caller-selected mask, distinguishing press-event state from continuously held buttons. The upstream input updater derives newly pressed bits and may OR-latch them; this query neither consumes nor clears those bits, so it does not itself guarantee one reaction per physical press.

evidence.why: Complete bank dispatch, explicit lists, inclusive ranges, fallthrough and metadata guard.
The classifier tests Popo/Nana kind and costume ID at least 2.

facts.rationale: Restores the omitted bank-13 fallthrough and its application beyond the Popo/Nana-specific range translation.
facts.value: A stateless conditional SFX-ID resolver. After audio-library remapping and bank classification, bank 0 adjusts only its explicit ID lists: one permits size offsets followed by an additional metal offset of 3, and the other permits size offsets only. In bank 13, Popo/Nana IDs in inclusive range 0x1FBFD–0x1FC62 gain 0x66 when ftCommon_80080144 is true; IDs in 0x1FC63–0x1FCC8 lose 0x66 when it is not true. Bank 13 then falls through, for every fighter kind, to the shared size-adjustment tail also used by banks 6–12, 14–31 and 33. That tail calls ft_80087C70 only when metadata lookup returns zero and the current ID is at least the bank offset plus lbAudioAx_80023220(bank). Other cases retain the remapped ID. No persistent state is written.

evidence.why: The wrapper only maps and submits the identifier.
Bounded duplicate refresh, sentinel-slot insertion and full-table fallthrough.
Conditional replay and clearing, otherwise aging.

facts.rationale: Adds useful cross-file lifetime and exceptional-capacity behavior missing from the existing auxiliary-trigger explanation, without interpreting submission as guaranteed immediate playback.
facts.value: Submits the fighter-adapted SFX ID to audio-library bookkeeping rather than starting playback immediately. lbAudioAx_80024DC4 searches 16 slots: an existing matching ID has its counter refreshed to 10; otherwise the first slot containing sentinel 0x83D60 receives the ID and counter 10. If neither exists, the request is silently omitted. A later audio update replays non-sentinel entries at maximum volume and centered pan when lbl_804D641C equals 1, clearing each entry afterward. Otherwise, while lbl_804D640C is clear, update ticks decrement the counters and discard expired entries. This wrapper stores no Fighter playback handle.
